a2-unit-46.46.1 Food for thought:
Kate: Food for thought. Why we love watching dinner party shows. A post from the Sweet Kate Bakery blog.
Kate: Reality TV has never been more popular. We've seen people on dates, at the doctor's office, and moving to a new house. But for me, the best topic for reality TV is food. And when food and cooking are combined with a competition for prizes, it's a winning formula. In one popular type of show, different people take turns cooking dinner for each other. Each meal gets a score, and the host with the highest score wins some money at the end of the week.
Kate: So why do we enjoy these shows so much? First of all, we all think we can do better. When we watch a host cutting up vegetables or mixing in the egg whites, we like to think, That's not the right way to do it!
Kate: We also enjoy watching the guests eating... or not eating. Some of the food is amazing, and the guests pig out happily. Others pick at their salad and say, I don't really like vegetables. Sometimes guests are on special diets. I gave up meat ten years ago, or, I'm trying to cut down on sugar. This is a big challenge for the hosts, who may have to make two different dishes.
Kate: Some of the more creative hosts don't even bother to cook! They just pick up takeout and heat it up for their guests. They don't usually win the prize money, though.
Kate: And what about the arguments? The TV producers like to turn up the heat by putting together people with very different ideas about life. We love watching the discussions that follow.
Kate: Will we ever get tired of these shows? I don't think so, because there are so many variations of food, people and homes. In my opinion, a good dinner party show is even better than eating out at a fancy restaurant!
